summary: All binding requirements and all 11 plan-review findings (2026-08-17-org-route-leads.md L192-274) verified as landed in code. Host allowlist is a true allowlist (loopback ∪ 100.64.0.0/10), not a denylist — server/src/external/org/_helpers.ts:61-65, tested both directions in _helpers.test.ts. Secret gate is a single shared secret via X-Shipwright-Leads-Secret, constant-time compare, fail-closed 503 when unset — _helpers.ts:79-89. Write allowlist is exactly 5 literals + charter pattern (6 kinds), org-chart.json explicitly excluded and unreachable through any PUT/POST path. Finding #2 (countersign keys on {timestamp,leadId}), #3 (idempotent retry, log-before-remove), #4 (symlink defense in decisions-lock.ts), #5 (leadId validation + TOCTOU fix), #7 (status-code order 403->503->401), #9 (no internal resolveHonoHost call, single module-scope call site), #10 (two-process serialization proof), #11 (strict anchored header regexes) all verified landed and tested. Lock contract matches FR-04.28 exactly (default lock path, stale:10_000, realpath:true explicit, auto-create before acquisition). No write path into shipwright_run_config.json / run_loop_state.json / Claude JSONL. No near-misses worth hardening before commit.
